results.title: By Dawn's Early Light
results.overview: Explores faith, liberty, and the American spirit, featuring cultural commentary and historical reflections on the challenges facing people of faith.

results.title: Nunya
results.overview: Nunya life is a complete kick. Her only love ex-boyfriend Lev is now dating another girl. In the company of the best friends, wine and shawarma, Nunya is desperately trying to realize who is to blame for the fact that her plan has failed. And most importantly - what to do when you want to drop everything and just be happy.

results.title: Living Twice, Dying Thrice
results.overview: Three miners who survived the collapse of a mine decide to hide their deaths so that their families can claim compensation. Their clandestine life gradually leads to new crises: family tensions, a desire to start anew, and a search for identity that brings them all the way to Teheran. Meanwhile, Iranian authorities await proof of death…

results.title: Tashi
results.overview: While still in elementary school, young Tashi rescued a stray dog. But the stray dog is adopted and named Tashi, which makes Tashi the laughing stock of his classmates. So little Tashi plans to kill the dog Tashi, but accidentally hits him blind. Tashi has been guilty for many years and suffers from eye disease. Tashi believes that this is the curse of the dog’s owner. Years later, when he becomes a famous writer and returns to his hometown, he learns another truth.

results.title: Philly Pretzels
results.overview: JUSTIN CROWELL | UNITED STATES | 2026 | 10 MIN | ENGLISH  Barry, a street-side soft pretzel salesman in South Philly, has an unexpected interaction with brash 19-year-old Brianna after a fight with her boyfriend leaves her stranded.  Cast: Adam Shapiro, Abigail Donaghy

results.title: Cadu: Cin Çıxarma
results.overview: This is a mockumentary-style project that humorously and satirically explores the themes of exorcism and family drama.

results.title: Baby Love
results.overview: A female MMA fighter on the brink of self-destruction finds a lifeline in a court-ordered equine therapy program, leading her to confront her past and redefine her future.

results.title: Harudu
results.overview: A thrilling and intense story. A righteous protagonist (DCP Shankar), a cruel antagonist (Varadharaj), a group of unsuspecting thieves who get entangled in a murder case, and the complex web of corruption, revenge, and justice.

results.title: Drug Hunt Mission
results.overview: Undercover police detective ferociously hunts down drug dealers; bloody lovers fight for their own masters! Drug enforcement police officer Ahren shoulders his mission, venturing deep into the tiger's den, facing an uncertain fate; he infiltrates the side of the brutal drug lord, Brother Chen, only to discover that Brother Chen's own sister is actually his lover. On one side is the love of life and death, the bond of blood; on the other is the mission of drug enforcement, the adherence to justice. Amidst a shocking mystery, good and evil clash, and the forces of good and evil engage in a showdown; in a desperate battle, where should one go?

results.title: Mono No Aware
results.overview: In Japan's quiet apartments, a Filipino kodokushi cleaner meets an elderly widower who asks him for one final favor before he dies. What begins as a promise becomes a quiet story of grief, family, and accepting life's impermanence.

results.title: Samson and Delilah
results.overview: A young woman working in an elite nightclub uses her beauty and intelligence to exploit and steal from wealthy customers.

results.title: Too Tight to Move
results.overview: A young traveler tries out a brand-new, top of the line massage chair.

results.title: 3x4
results.overview: Confined to her workplace, a woman laments her friend’s final day on the job. As the farewell draws near, daydreams begin to take over her daily routine.

results.title: Murder In Melbourne
results.overview: When Amarjeet Singh disappears after sending his wife Simran a cryptic message, Detective Shergil investigates. His search uncovers family secrets, illicit affairs, betrayal and a property dispute. When Amarjeet's body is found and Simran vanishes, the case turns darker. As suspects die and clues lead in different directions, Shergil must confront his past to catch the killer.

results.title: Gentle by Birth
results.overview: After her 23-year-old brother dies of an overdose, filmmaker Doree Simon Hatfield investigates the stigma she believes blocked his access to treatment and support. Her search takes her from her family’s living room to harm reduction sites, music festivals, and the halls of the Pennsylvania Capitol, where she meets experts working to change how addiction is understood and treated. But as her own fear and stigma around drugs begin to dissolve, Doree makes a radical choice to try them herself—transforming the film from a dissection of her brother’s addiction into a provocative reckoning that threatens her family’s fragile healing.

results.title: Lockdown
results.overview: During a sudden prison lockdown, a group of incarcerated men confront the emotional weight of confinement and discover that solidarity and human connection may be the only way through the darkness.

results.title: Stay Good
results.overview: After causing a horrific accident, a young college student attempts to become a better person.
